name: Ray-marched Volumetric Lighting with Density Thresholding
definition: A GPU compute shader technique that simulates light attenuation through a volumetric medium by ray-marching from each voxel in the light texture space towards the global light direction, accumulating density and applying Beer-Lambert-like exponential decay.
summary: Ray-marched Volumetric Lighting with Density Thresholding precomputes light attenuation in a 3D texture via ray-marching, differing from static shading by explicitly simulating volumetric light transport.
